podcast.title: Drum Kit from Paul Cook
podcast.body: June Miles Kingston acquired her first drum kit from Paul Cook of The Sex Pistols, establishing an early connection to punk rock history. She later went on to perform with various notable bands across different genres. "June Miles Kingston bought her first drum kit from Paul Cook of The Sex Pistols."
